' ) def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and embed a blog headline and its content into an HTML template. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading of the blog post. content : str The full text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A complete HTML snippet ready for display on a webpage. Raises ------ TypeError If either ``headline`` or ``content`` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("content must be a string") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
